FlexiblePlane.DrawDescription: Draws a textured ribbon from a connected point list or position history, with width, tint, facing and UV controls.
FlexiblePlane.ListDescription: Provides an ordered list of positions, widths and colors for a Flexible Plane Draw; the first four positions can be connected.
FlexiblePlane.HistoryDescription: Samples position, width and color over time to provide a capacity- and age-bounded trail to a Flexible Plane Draw.
